Learn: Why no pick is guaranteed
Even a 65% pick loses 1 time in 3.

Probability is not certainty.
A 65% pick loses 35% of the time.
Out of 10 such picks, 3 or 4 losses is normal. It is not a failure.

Streaks happen.
If your picks truly win 60%, you will still have a stretch of 10 with 4 or fewer wins about 1 time in 6.
That is why we publish every win and every loss.
